segments.he: מְיוּחָסוֹת שֶׁבָּהֶן הָיוּ אוֹמְרוֹת: בָּחוּר וְכוּ׳. תָּנוּ רַבָּנַן: יְפֵיפִיּוֹת שֶׁבָּהֶן מָה הָיוּ אוֹמְרוֹת — תְּנוּ עֵינֵיכֶם לַיּוֹפִי, שֶׁאֵין הָאִשָּׁה אֶלָּא לְיוֹפִי. מְיוּחָסוֹת שֶׁבָּהֶן מָה הָיוּ אוֹמְרוֹת — תְּנוּ עֵינֵיכֶם לַמִּשְׁפָּחָה, לְפִי שֶׁאֵין הָאִשָּׁה אֶלָּא לְבָנִים. מְכוֹעָרוֹת שֶׁבָּהֶם מָה הָיוּ אוֹמְרוֹת — קְחוּ מִקַּחֲכֶם לְשׁוּם שָׁמַיִם, וּבִלְבַד שֶׁתְּעַטְּרוּנוּ בִּזְהוּבִים.
segments.en: It is taught that «those» women «of distinguished lineage among them would say: Young man,» please lift up your eyes and see what you choose for a wife. «The Sages taught» this practice in greater detail in a baraita: «What would the beautiful women among them say? Set your eyes toward beauty, as a wife is only for her beauty. What would those of distinguished lineage among them say? Set your eyes toward family, as a wife is only for children,» and the children of a wife from a distinguished family will inherit her lineage. «What would the ugly ones among them say? Acquire your purchase for the sake of Heaven, provided that you adorn us with golden jewelry» after our marriage to beautify us.
